crm.query: Compare HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, Zoho CRM, and Close on pricing and what changed this month.

results.title: Zoho CRM adds Zia Agents; Standard plan holds at $14
results.content: Zoho CRM announced Zia Agents at its November release event. "Zoho CRM Standard remains $14 per user per month, billed annually, with no change to list pricing." The new Zia Agents can research accounts, score leads, and draft emails. Zoho said the agents are included in Standard and above at launch, with usage limits of 1,000 actions per user per month.

results.title: Pipedrive price update: Essential plan
results.content: Pipedrive pricing update, published 10 November 2026. Pipedrive has raised the list price of its Essential plan. "Essential now costs $16 per user per month billed annually, up from $14." The Growth plan remains $29 per user per month and the Professional plan remains $49 per user per month. The company said existing annual customers keep their current rate until renewal. Pipedrive also announced that its AI Sales Assistant is now generally available on Growth and above.

results.title: Salesforce Starter Suite pricing and Agentforce 2.0
results.content: Salesforce updated Starter Suite pricing on 10 November 2026. "Starter Suite is now $29 per user per month, up from $25." Sales Cloud Starter and Service Cloud Starter are included in the suite. Salesforce also said "Agentforce 2.0 is now included in Starter Suite for up to 1,000 conversations per month." Additional conversations are billed separately. The change applies to new subscriptions from 1 December 2026.

results.title: HubSpot: Starter pricing unchanged, Breeze Agents now GA
results.content: HubSpot published its November product update. "The Starter Customer Platform remains $20 per seat per month with no pricing change." HubSpot also announced "Breeze Agents are now generally available across Starter and Professional tiers." The agents can qualify leads and draft follow-ups. HubSpot said there is no additional charge for the first 2,000 agent actions per account each month.

results.title: Close launches AI Inbox; pricing unchanged
results.content: Close released AI Inbox on 10 November 2026. "Close pricing is unchanged: the base plan remains $29 per user per month." AI Inbox summarizes threads, drafts replies, and suggests next steps. The feature is available on all paid plans. Close said it will not charge separately for AI Inbox during the beta period, which runs through January 2027.

postgres.query: Compare Neon, Supabase, and Amazon RDS pricing.

results.title: Amazon RDS PostgreSQL instance price change
results.content: AWS updated the on-demand price for a commonly used RDS PostgreSQL instance. "The db.t4g.medium instance is now $0.072 per hour, up from $0.068 per hour" in the US East (N. Virginia) region. The price change takes effect on 1 December 2026. AWS said reserved instances and Savings Plans are unaffected. The db.t4g.small remains $0.034 per hour.

results.title: Neon updates Launch plan pricing
results.content: Neon posted a pricing change for its managed Postgres Launch plan on 11 November 2026. "The Launch plan is now $24 per month, up from $19 per month." The plan still includes 100 GB of storage and 300 compute hours. Neon said the change reflects higher demand for autoscaling and branch restore. Existing Launch customers will see the new price at their next billing cycle.

results.title: Supabase Pro plan pricing unchanged
results.content: Supabase published a status and pricing note on 11 November 2026. "The Supabase Pro plan remains $25 per month and has not changed." The plan includes 8 GB database space, 100 GB file storage, and 250 GB egress. Supabase also said its read replica and branching features remain available on the Pro plan with usage-based add-ons.
